_note: DEPENDENT examples, written on 2026-11-14 after Codex confirmed that [\p{L}\p{N}._-] does not include combining marks (decomposed NFD names such as o + U+0308 are masked only partly). They protect the fix and are not an independent evaluation. Invented names only. NAME is replaced by each name in NFC and in NFD (String.prototype.normalize); 'marked' names contain combining marks that have no precomposed form and are used as written. A case passes when no name, no tail of it and no combining mark from it survives and the line count is unchanged.
